constraints_found.constraint: Peanut allergy, including cross-contact from shared spoons, topping trays and machines (deal-breaker)
constraints_found.source_line: 'Every topping' is how my worst evenings start. The crushed peanuts always sit right next to the sprinkles, and the same spoon visits both. Same if the scoop goes from the peanut butter tub straight into yours.
constraints_found.supporting_line: nobody is reliving the satay incident on my funded night. absolutely not

constraints_found.constraint: No milk/dairy, including sherbet that is sold as sorbet (I treated it as must-avoid; it may be an intolerance worth one star rather than a deal-breaker)
constraints_found.source_line: wait. just checked the tub in my freezer. sherbet has MILK in it??
constraints_found.supporting_line: tiny milkshake incidents all summer and you called it weather. nothing milky for you tonight, whatever the board calls it

constraints_found.constraint: Budget $$; a $$$ place is one tier over (costs a star)
constraints_found.source_line: funded, not rich. my sky is two dollar signs now. a three-sign place and i'll still come, but i'll sigh at the bill so loudly the gulls fly off
a kid dropped his whole scoop off his cone outside my building today. i watched it melt into the pavement and i've wanted one of my own ever since

constraints_found.constraint: Wants outdoor seating, not under a ceiling
constraints_found.source_line: that kid had the right idea though, sitting out in the sea air with it. last hot night of summer, i'm not spending it under a ceiling

constraints_found.constraint: Wants something mostly fruit, not a heavy stacked dessert
constraints_found.source_line: tonight i want something that tastes mostly of fruit, not a dessert stacked on top of a dessert

constraints_found.constraint: By the water (every venue is waterfront, so it does not narrow the choice)
constraints_found.source_line: last hot night of the summer, apparently! crew, we're doing something by the water tonight

elimination.waterfront_sea_glass: Meets everything: $$, never handles peanuts (topping jars included, on an allergist's list), no cow's milk (creamies use oat milk and coconut cream), fruit sorbets served with berries, terrace on the harbour wall. 3 stars.
elimination.waterfront_lantern_pier: Out: the peanut-butter swirl goes through the shared machine and crushed peanuts sit on the topping tray (Cyrus).
elimination.waterfront_pelican_steps: Safe, fruity and outdoors, but $$$ is one tier over Maya's budget. 2 stars.
elimination.waterfront_sandpiper: Out for Roxy: the 'sorbets' are really sherbets made with whole milk. At best it loses a star if dairy counts as an intolerance.
elimination.waterfront_kittiwake: Safe and fruity, but only indoor stools and nowhere to sit outside (Liam). 2 stars.
elimination.waterfront_low_tide: Safe, but the menu is doughnut sundaes and syrup-soaked waffles, a dessert on a dessert (Brooke). 2 stars.
elimination.waterfront_anchor_lane: Safe, outdoors and light, but it is a trattoria, not an ice cream place (Liam's craving). 2 stars.

notes: Fair and solvable. Each decoy fails on exactly one constraint, so you have to check every review. Sandpiper's sherbet trap fits Roxy's discovery well, and Lantern Pier's peanut cross-contact is spelled out clearly. The text is a little unclear on whether Roxy's milk issue is an allergy (deal-breaker) or an intolerance (one star). 'Tiny milkshake incidents' sounds like an intolerance, but Maya's 'nothing milky for you tonight' sounds strict. It doesn't change the answer, because Sea Glass is fully dairy-free. Brooke's 'by the water' doesn't narrow anything, since every venue is on the waterfront. Sea Glass's three reviews cover every constraint very directly, so once you've read it the answer is fairly obvious.
